items.title: How an Insider CEO Is Taking a Fresh Look at Charles River
items.summary: “I want to roll out my strategy to them so that they know why we’re doing things, why the urgency, what are we trying to accomplish and really what it means to them,” Girshick told me during a recent visit to the Leadership Institute’s offices.  It’s just one way an ultimate insider is in some ways acting as if she’s an outsider in her quest to transform  Charles River  which provides drug-development services.  Girshick, who started at Charles River as an executive assistant in her home country of Germany, is just the third CEO in the company’s nearly 80-year history and the first unrelated to the founder.

items.title: 5 Insightful Analyst Questions From Charles River Laboratories’s Q2 Earnings Call
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories’ second quarter results were shaped by recovering biopharmaceutical demand and the impact of portfolio streamlining. Management highlighted that the rebound was most evident in the Discovery and Safety Assessment (DSA) segment, where net book-to-bill reached a four-year high and organic revenue growth turned positive for the first time since 2023.
